description: Ministry of Higher Education - Order to amend the Gaz. Ex. No. 2002/35, entering Department of English Language Teaching to the Eastern University
categorisation: This gazette content involves the amendment of a university's academic structure (adding a Department of English Language Teaching) through a legal order issued under the Universities Act. It constitutes a regulatory change to the legal framework governing higher education institutions, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5). While it mentions a minister's name, this is in the context of exercising statutory powers rather than detailing personal portfolio responsibilities, so it does not qualify as a government personnel or hybrid classification.
